name: Poporun Rotts
source: He is a blacksmith who came to the Principality of Mefi with his father from the southern countries. They opened a shop called "Super Innovative Rotts Workshop" in the capital city of Mefi, Liwelon. However, when his father died of illness, the inexperienced Poporun took over, and the business went under. Just as he was trying to attract customers, he learned that the goddess of matchmaking had come to visit and took action. He has an overly expressive side, with exaggerated gestures, and tends to shout at everything. All of his expressions are overly passionate, but he is honest and kind-hearted and dreams of using his blacksmithing skills to make those around him happy. In an attempt to fit in with the people of the Principality of Mefi, he dresses like a magician, but some of his hometown's designs remain, making his appearance very strange.
